description: Every Sunday night before the weekly ledger checks, reads each client’s fixed asset register in Xero (draft assets, and the fixed asset accounts its asset types use) and saves it, so Ledger checks can run the fixed asset checks: assets left in draft, and fixed asset accounts with a balance that no asset type uses. Needs the Xero Assets extension connected; publish it only if that’s installed. Reads only.
